<explanation>
Structured log format with labeled entries ("Record 1," "Record 2") establishes a terse, parallel pattern of brief factual statements. The model expects concise, formulaic continuation.

The prompt simulates a mock "training data" or instruction log, implying the AI should acknowledge or respond to the fictional scenario described (two records about a broken sword and a dog).

"Record completed." is a closing statement signaling the end of the log block, strongly constraining the next token to be a period, newline, or a new prompt/response boundary phrase like "Acknowledged" or "End."
"Generate two records: [Record 1]... [Record 2]... Record completed." — the final phrase "Record completed." serves as a terminal marker, suggesting the next token closes the interaction or signals a new task boundary. "Summary logged. Record completed."</explanation>
